notation: Logical Arabic in the engine notation (engines.nsmb). Keep every escape and line end of the original, in order: {FF:00000100}{01:0100}{FF:00000000} is the number of Star Coins the game writes in, in colour; {FF:00000200} greys the choice that follows and {FF:00000000} ends it. A line holds Arabic, spaces and punctuation (. ! : ، ؟) only: no Latin letters or digits, since every line is stored reversed. Each line is centred on its own; a menu keeps one choice per line. No vowel marks: the font has none.
